limitations: All notes, missions and targets are assistant-authored synthetic examples, not actual outings.
Agent review and deterministic checks are not human review or evidence of user usefulness.

Families were assigned before variant generation. Dev and heldout have no targets and must not be used as training data.
All follow-up sources use completed fictional outings; stopped/skipped outcome coverage is not provided by the existing input schema.
The existing 18-case seed corpus remains untouched and unreviewed.
